# Étoile Atelier Architecture & Design System

> Luxury jewelry e-commerce platform built with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI, and shadcn/ui.

## Stack
- Framework: Next.js (App Router) + React 19
- Primitive Library: Base UI (@base-ui/react)
- Component Library: shadcn/ui (style: base-sera, taupe palette)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @theme inline and strict token invariance
- Typography: Playfair Display (Serif headings) + Noto Sans (Body)
- Database: Native MongoDB Driver (maxPoolSize: 5, minPoolSize: 0, maxIdleTimeMS: 30000)
- Validation: Zod across all boundaries
- State: Nuqs for URL state management
- Animation: Motion (Framer Motion)
